A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F. The added Appendix G in v2 visibly contains only a heading; this is not an extraction gap.

before.justification: Section 6 reports original view-synthesis, ablation, and tomography experiments in Tables 1–3. Appendices A, E, and F include simulation comparisons, per-scene metrics, and reconstructed images.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the authors' explicitly identified experimental runs in Tables 1 and 3 and the supplementary results in Appendices A, E, and F.

M1.justification: The analytic alpha computation, density reparameterization, and densification/pruning procedures are unchanged. The new heading-only Appendix G provides no new tile-size algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use Mip-NeRF360, Tanks&Temples, DeepBlending, and the same synthetic and real tomography datasets. Shape-fitting and overlapping/non-overlapping Gaussian test scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Table 1, including 3DGS-Slang, GES, Don't Splat, and EVER, and in Table 3, including R2-Gaussian. The ablation and ray-marching comparisons also retain their comparators.

E3.justification: The train/test splits, metrics, reported 30,000-iteration evaluations, 25-view tomography protocol, and primitive-budget controls remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the same simulation settings.

E4.justification: Both retain the parameterization and hyperparameter ablations in Table 2, primitive-budget analysis in Figure 5, calibration failure example in Figure 6, and overlap analysis in Appendix A/Figure 7.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Scene averaging and the reporting of results without uncertainty estimates remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1–6 and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, the proposed method's Mip-NeRF360 results remain 27.30 PSNR, 0.813 SSIM, and 0.209 LPIPS; synthetic tomography remains 35.08 PSNR and 0.922 SSIM.

T1.justification: The volume-rendering derivations, sorting and non-overlap assumptions, analytic Gaussian integration, and Appendix B proof are unchanged. Appendix G adds no mathematical content.

C1.justification: The claims about physically accurate alpha computation, opaque-surface representation, view-synthesis quality, and tomography are retained. Removing the duplicated tomography passage from the abstract leaves one identical statement of the claim.

C2.justification: Interpretations of perceptual quality, opacity, runtime, and tomography remain unchanged. Sections 7–8 retain the same sorting/overlap and calibration limitations and the same discussion of tile-size heuristics.

D1.justification: Section 5 and Appendices C–D retain the same implementation, hyperparameters, hardware, and training-time details, along with the promise to release code after publication. The empty Appendix G discloses no additional technical information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, reference list, and research positioning are unchanged. Text displaced between pages 1 and 2 is retained through reflow.

P1.justification: v2 removes a duplicated two-sentence tomography passage from the abstract and adds the empty heading 'G. Gaussian tile size computation without splatting.' The remaining prose and substantive section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The shortened abstract causes text reflow on pages 1–2. Page 15 adds the Appendix G heading and slightly adjusts table/text spacing. Figures, captions, and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Removing the repeated tomography passage makes the abstract cleaner, while adding an empty Appendix G leaves an unfinished section heading. These small editorial changes have little net effect on overall quality; the methods, evidence, proofs, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
